relationships.rationale: Executable Usage subject routing depends on the canonical subject identity and fallback/conflict rules, but wiring authority and identity authority remain distinct.
Artifact-to-Usage and Ledger correlation depends on canonical Usage route identity while preserving a separate artifact-navigation consumer lifecycle.
The run-graph Usage cost overlay consumes canonical route identity but has its own degraded-overlay behavior.
Artifact drill-through requires canonical Usage identity, while absent-identity GUI behavior remains a distinct consumer promise.
Drill-through availability interacts with cost_usage join validity, but navigation behavior and record-creation validity are separate lifecycles.
Evidence-bound Usage presentation depends on unambiguous token-bucket value states while retaining separate display and accounting authority.
Usage display truth depends on coherent cost and quota arithmetic, but presentation policy is not the arithmetic lifecycle.
Usage pressure warnings depend on account-pressure episode transitions and reset/unblock truth while remaining a distinct warning consumer.
Account failover consumes pressure state and reset transitions, but pool selection and failover concurrency are a separate authority and lifecycle.
cost_usage join validity depends on canonical Usage records and rebuildable projection joins, but artifact validity remains separately governed.
The runtime artifact envelope carries the join field whose delayed or unavailable target creates the separate join-state contradiction.
Usage rollups depend on attributed usage events, while rollup replay/recovery and attribution settlement remain distinct lifecycles.
Budget configuration UI interacts with runtime budget enforcement, but control-surface semantics and dispatch enforcement authority are distinct.
Quota pause and confirmation may be triggered by budget enforcement, but confirmer authority and pause/resume state are separate from atomic dispatch checks.
Fixed concept selector families can conflict with provider-specific rolling, fixed, billing, session, or unknown windows; GUI selection and provider evidence remain distinct.
The concept Compact Now control invokes the retention/compaction workflow, but UI progress recovery and retention rollback are distinct lifecycles.
Representable negative adjustment amounts interact with immutable correction and supersession ordering, without collapsing amount representation into correction lifecycle.
Concurrent settlement arbitration interacts with retry lineage and stream termination, but settlement authority and retry recovery remain distinct state machines.
User-directed Usage exports and optional observability exporter configuration share projection inputs but differ in authority, delivery lifecycle, and user-visible promise.
Widget Usage value-state transitions interact with the shared Usage identity/redaction projection, but widget consumer behavior and global projection authority remain distinct.
